scoring_justification: Headline quantities are fixed predictions from a specific computational protocol; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible in a lightweight verifier, so result-level comparison against paper-reported values with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold eigenvalues and equilibrium properties from paper Tables 2 and 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Srivastava 1983 J. Phys. C: Solid State Phys. 16 1649, Table 2 and Table 3
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported values; they are the authentic reference.

outputs.description: Electronic band energies at high-symmetry points Γ, X, L produced by the self-consistent non-local pseudopotential calculation with spin-orbit coupling.
Equilibrium lattice constant, total energy, and bulk modulus of α-Sn derived from DFT total energy calculations at multiple lattice constants and a polynomial fit.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent's submitted eigenvalues and equilibrium properties to reference values using appropriate tolerances. Scoring rewards honest reproduction of the computational procedure.

steps.description: Compare each eigenvalue list to gold within tolerance. Fraction of matched eigenvalues per k-point averaged.
Compare equilibrium properties to gold within per-field tolerances; score is fraction of fields within tolerance.
